ABOUT US 

 PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. 

 PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY®, and HARTRIDGE™. With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 12,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 20 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. Read More 
 
 JOB PURPOSE 
 
Support product approval of aftermarket steering & suspension product
Work in collaboration with product line, purchase, supplier quality and external suppliers to plan and execute product development and validation. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
 Key Accountabilities 
 Collate and record product attributes within the PADB (Product Attribute Data Base) and CCU (Carsource Catalogue Utility) for all new to range part introductions.  Collate & update product data in NPI (New Product Introduction) workflow.
 Collate, record and maintain Bill Of Materials within the CCU (Carsource Catalogue Utility) for all new to range part introductions and MCIP related activities.
 Complete RFC (Request for Product Classification) across all new to range part introductions, support technical questions related to product specification for RFC completion.
 Maintain engineering documents in designated repository’s – drawings, design validation reports, product images.
 Support product engineering group with updates and revisions of engineering processes and procedures within the quality management system.
 
 Key Competencies 
 BS in Engineering.
 Knowledge and experience of automotive aftermarket is desirable.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills English.
 Must be detail oriented with excellent organization and time management skills with ability to work independently. 
 Proficient in computer skills including Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
 SharePoint document library administration knowledge.
 Ability to routinely work in a hands-on environment.
 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

 PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

 VISA SPONSORSHIP   

 For this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis in the country where the position is based. Only in certain circumstances, based on business need, does PHINIA provide sponsorship for employment visa status.

 NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS 

 PHINIA does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or third-party vendors. Any recruitment partnership must be approved in writing by Human Resources before candidate submissions are made.

 GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT 
 
Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your  ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
 Please access the linked document by clicking here , select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review. 
 Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.
 
 Career Scam Disclaimer:   
 PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website.  To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities. 
 
 
 
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com .
